title: FTC warns Novo that current Metsera offer structure may violate US merger law
summary: In a letter to lawyers for Novo and Metsera, an FTC official wrote that the proposed purchase of Metsera by the Danish pharma "may violate the procedural provisions" of the Hart-Scott-Rodino (HSR) Act.

title: Inside Trump’s scramble to reduce US dependence on Chinese rare-earth metals
summary: The White House has made it a top priority to return the rare-earth industry to US shores. But is it really feasible?Scott Bessent, the US treasury secretary, returned from South Carolina last week brandishing a small piece of metal, proclaiming that it was the first rare-earth magnet made in the US in a quarter of a century.It was, he indicated toFox Business, proof that the US is ending “China’s chokehold on our supply chain”. Thanks to theSouth Carolinacompany eVAC’s new rare-earth mineral processing center, Bessent added: “We’re finally becoming independent again.”Continue reading...

title: Senator Tim Scott pushes for December vote on crypto market bill
summary: Senate Banking Chair Tim Scott says the committee could mark up a crypto market structure bill in December, sending it to President Donald Trump for early 2026.

title: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says Trump's Greenland push is about avoiding a 'hot war'
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said US annexation of Greenland is a national security strategy meant to avoid a future armed conflict.
